title: Miao Miao 2 (FSL 14days eu) and xdrip+
symptom: Miao Miao 2 works with the tomato app, but when activated in xdrip+, the connection status shows 'connected' in system status, yet no input is received while 'collecting initial readings'. The data collector is green but it gets stuck on receiving data from LimiTTer collector.
cause: The xDrip+ version was not the latest; the user had an older version (20190518) which caused the issue.
fix: Update xDrip+ to version 20190930-7d97b62.apk, after which the collector changes from LimiTTER to Tomato and everything works.
evidence_quote: I have switched to 20190930-7d97b62.apk and now, as soon as the collector change to LimiTTER to Tomato, everything run fine.
